propositions: Cancelled runs on main render as red X in GitHub despite main being healthy, because push-triggered workflows share a concurrency group keyed on main ref and cancel previous runs
Main CI should be scheduled every 6 hours instead of push-triggered to surface main health as a single run covering multiple commits rather than per-commit green/red status

Push triggers must be removed from main for test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, and terraform-drift.yml while preserving non-main branch push CI via branches-ignore
Scheduled main health runs must emit remediation guidance to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY including a copy-pasteable git bisect start command with both bad and last-known-green SHA filled in
Last-known-green main SHA must be resolved from successful run history via Actions API and published for bisect lower bound; lookup failure must degrade gracefully without blocking green runs
On-demand workflow_dispatch must be added to all main health workflows so operators can check main status without waiting for the schedule tick
